---
title: Quick start
---

## Before you start

Use Python 3.11 or newer and a clone of this toolkit review branch. This
development version has no public package release. Your private project must
already contain reviewed QMD, an evidence profile and a trusted Python renderer
that accepts `--watch` and `--profile NAME`.

For Quarto PDF/Word rendering, install Quarto and the TeX/fonts required by that
project. Quarto-managed TinyTeX can supply XeLaTeX without placing it on PATH.
The toolkit installs no rendering software or fonts. Inspect unfamiliar renderer
scripts before executing them.

## 1. Install from the toolkit checkout

These commands use a local virtual environment. Windows commands call its
executables directly, avoiding changes to shell execution policy.

::: {.panel-tabset}
### macOS

```sh
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install .
```

### Windows PowerShell

```powershell
py -3 -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install .
```
:::

## 2. Preview adoption

Stay in the toolkit checkout. Replace the project path with your own clone.
Paths after `--qmd` and `--evidence-profile` are relative to that private project.

::: {.panel-tabset}
### macOS

```sh
.venv/bin/cv-buid adopt /path/to/private-project --renderer render.py --evidence-profile private/profile.json --qmd private/quarto/resume.qmd --qmd private/quarto/full-cv.qmd --dry-run
```

### Windows PowerShell

```powershell
.venv\Scripts\cv-buid.exe adopt C:/path/to/private-project --renderer render.py --evidence-profile private/profile.json --qmd private/quarto/resume.qmd --qmd private/quarto/full-cv.qmd --dry-run
```
:::

Review the plan and repeat without `--dry-run` to create `cv-buid.json` and
`.agents/skills/cv-project/SKILL.md`. Existing adoption targets cause a refusal;
there is no overwrite option. Existing `AGENTS.md`, QMD, evidence and presentation
files stay intact. Each private project keeps its own instructions.

## 3. Edit QMD, then build

Edit the requested QMD variant directly in your private project. From the toolkit
checkout, use the installed executable to select that project:

::: {.panel-tabset}
### macOS

```sh
.venv/bin/cv-buid build --project /path/to/private-project
.venv/bin/cv-buid build --project /path/to/private-project --watch
```

### Windows PowerShell

```powershell
.venv\Scripts\cv-buid.exe build --project C:/path/to/private-project
.venv\Scripts\cv-buid.exe build --project C:/path/to/private-project --watch
```
:::

If `cv-buid` is on PATH, you can instead run `cv-buid build` from the private
project root. Ctrl+C stops watch mode. Read your renderer's instructions for
output paths and font/profile requirements; `--profile NAME` is forwarded to it.
Restart watching after changing config, renderer code or toolkit installation.

## If something fails

- **Adoption target exists:** inspect the existing config/skill and compare it
  manually. Preserve it rather than rerunning adoption over it.
- **Tool, profile or font missing:** follow the private renderer's error and
  setup instructions. No font is silently substituted.
- **Output open in Word/PDF software:** close it and retry if the renderer reports
  a replacement lock, especially on Windows.
- **New project without a renderer:** this prototype's adoption path is not yet
  a complete starter. See the [v1 priorities](v1.qmd).
